name: com.dnsfix/dnsfix
title: DNSFix
description: Check any domain's email and DNS setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, SSL) in plain English, with the fix.

tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Checks a domain's public DNS for email and website problems (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, SSL, expiry and more). Returns the grade, the top problems in plain words, the record to paste for the first fix, and a link to the full DNSFix™ report. Public data only; no sign-in needed.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

detail.description: Optional: true returns every check in full. Leave it out for the short answer.

tools.name: check_record
tools.description: Tests a DNS record someone gave you (from a chatbot, a DNS host or a web person) against the domain's live records before it is published: SPF lookups and dropped senders, DMARC that would block your own mail, DKIM keys, MX moves, CNAME clashes. Says safe, careful or stop. Never publishes anything.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

record.description: The record as you were given it, for example: TXT _dmarc "v=DMARC1; p=reject"

host.description: Optional: the host or name field, if it was given separately

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Reads a domain's SPF record and counts its DNS lookups against the limit of 10, with void lookups, includes and other mistakes in plain words.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Reads a domain's DMARC record: the policy, every tag explained, and what to change.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Finds a domain's DKIM keys at the usual selector names (or the one you give) and checks key type, length, hash and test mode.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

selector.description: Optional: the DKIM selector, for example google or selector1

tools.name: check_propagation
tools.description: Asks six big public DNS services (US, Europe and Asia) for the same record and says whether a change has reached them, and how long older copies last.

name.description: A DNS name, for example yourbusiness.com or _dmarc.yourbusiness.com

expect.description: Optional: the new value you expect, or part of it

tools.name: lookup_dns
tools.description: Looks up one record type for a name, with each record's time to live and whether it is signed with DNSSEC.

name.description: A DNS name, for example yourbusiness.com or _dmarc.yourbusiness.com

tools.name: build_dmarc_record
tools.description: Writes a DMARC record for a domain as text, with where to add it and what each part does. It is never published: the domain owner adds it at their DNS host.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

subdomain_policy.description: Optional: policy for subdomains (sp=). Leave it out to use the main policy

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Lists the domains your DNSFix™ account watches, with the latest grade and expiry dates. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: The latest check for one of your watched domains: grade, top problems and the record to paste. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

detail.description: Optional: true returns every check in full. Leave it out for the short answer.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Recent alerts (changes, problems, expiry warnings, things resolved) for your watched domains, newest first. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.

limit.description: Optional: how many alerts to return, 1 to 100 (default 20)

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Grade and score over time for one of your watched domains. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

days.description: Optional: how many days back to look, 1 to 365 (default 30)

tools.name: get_dmarc_summary
tools.description: Who sent email as your domain (from DMARC reports) and how much passed SPF or DKIM. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

days.description: Optional: how many days of reports to sum up, 1 to 90 (default 30)

tools.name: what_to_fix_next
tools.description: Picks the one thing to fix next across your watched domains (or one domain you name), most urgent first: what is wrong, why it matters, the record to paste and the fix guide link, then the next few after it. Read-only: nothing is changed, and the domain owner makes the change at their DNS host. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.
